symptom: A Starlark rule could not see an empty folder: the catalog had no folders table, so a folder existed for a rule only as the folder of a document in it, and 'every module has the folders Objects and UI' reported an empty folder as missing. Separately, `select ... from CATALOG.AGENTS` printed nothing and exited 0.
cause: No folders pass, although buildHierarchy already lists every folder for the documents' folder paths. CATALOG.AGENTS: AGENTS is a lexer keyword missing from catalogTableName, so the SELECT parsed to zero statements, with no error.
insight: Three things that would have saved time. (1) A new CATALOG.<name> whose name is a lexer keyword (FOLDERS from LIST FOLDERS) parses to NOTHING, not to an error, and exits 0; this was the fourth such table after COMMUNITIES, QUEUES and AGENTS. TestEveryCatalogTableParses now parses every name Catalog.Tables() lists, and found AGENTS on its first run. If `select` prints nothing, try the same table in a subquery: that goes to SQL unparsed and works. (2) LIST FOLDERS already lists empty folders and is the cross-check: diff its per-folder counts against the table. On CitrusGrove all 179 folders matched; the one spelling difference was DeepLink's folder NAMED 'Pages/Snippets', which LIST FOLDERS escapes and the Folder column does not, and it broke a depth computed by counting slashes. Walk the parents. (3) A pass must not list through b.reader (TestBuilderListsDocumentsThroughTheScope); build from b.hierarchy, which already holds every folder.
